component: EWS folder repair and browser-test event ordering

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned EWS repair branch clears ewsSyncStateToken before backing up and closing the message database, then starts updateFolder. The sync consumer reads this opaque folder token; clearing it allows the message list to be fetched without the previous sync state. IMAP transfer-info handling remains separate. The changed test corrupts local IDs, consumes an initial FolderLoaded event, then registers a new event promise before Repair and awaits it after closing the dialog. Its entries loops pair each message with the saved expected ID. The final loop has no direct final-count assertion, so it alone does not prove all three original messages were returned. Exact accepted source retains these contracts after the repair/test paths move; Graph handling and local-store recreation are later changes. Shared-test var imports and the documented Exchange2013 fake-server default are local harness facts. No runtime result is claimed.
title: EWS folder repair clears sync state before rebuilding the message list
